name: adsbeast
description: Work with your own ADS Beast advertising workspace: leads with attribution, campaigns, clients, alerts, tasks, conversion outcomes and webhooks. Requires an ADS Beast account and a scoped API key.

api_key.title: ADS Beast API key
api_key.description: A scoped key from ADS Beast under API Keys, starting with absk_. Minting one requires an admin account. The scopes on the key decide what this plugin can reach.
